answer: The prism counter is kept in hollow and dawn reveals each reset. An farming party thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 560 identities would post 2931 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
